pages.organisations.intro.source: Thinkerwell is a student-led platform working to expand access to free digital social studies learning for underserved youth across Southeast Asia. We are preparing a pilot of our course with learning organisations. This page explains what a pilot involves.

pages.organisations.intro.back: Thinkerwell is a student-run platform, striving to widen access to free digital social science learning for youth lacking learning conditions across Southeast Asia. pages.organisations.honesty.back: Thinkerwell is a student-run platform. It is not a registered charity or non-profit organisation.

pages.organisations.whatBody.source: One course, Exploring Our World: {lessons} lessons about history, geography, culture and civic life, for learners aged about 10 to 17. Each lesson has five steps: read, write, speak, watch and reflect. It runs in a web browser on shared laptops and tablets, in English or Bahasa Indonesia. Lessons work offline after the first visit; the optional videos need the internet.

Left as is (promise only what is true today); a human should decide whether the Vietnamese page should mention Vietnamese once it is ready.
pages.organisations.whatBody.back: One course, Exploring Our World: {lessons} lessons on history, geography, culture and civic life, for learners about 10 to 17 years old. Each lesson has five steps: read, write, speak, watch and reflect. The course runs in a web browser, on shared laptops and tablets, in English or Indonesian. The lessons work without internet after the first visit; the optional videos need internet.

pages.organisations.privacy1.source: Pilot groups can use codes instead of names. Each learner gets a code card, like HLP-01, and types the code as their name. Only you keep the list that matches codes to names.

pages.organisations.privacy2.source: No accounts, no email addresses and no ads. Learners' work stays on the device they use, and voice recordings never leave it.
pages.organisations.privacy2.back: No accounts, no email addresses and no ads. Learners' work stays on the device they use, and voice recordings never leave the device.

pages.organisations.privacy3.source: Parental consent. Before any learning data is shared with Thinkerwell, a parent or guardian signs a consent form, and the learner says yes too. The study would only use data linked to a code, never a name: short questions and a few sentences in the first and last sessions, and, in every session, how learners use Thinkerwell: time, lessons and steps, answers, the help they use, videos and word counts, never what they write.
pages.organisations.privacy3.note: Long privacy/consent sentence; must match the consent form wording (pages.pilotStudy). Check 'dữ liệu học tập', 'sự trợ giúp họ dùng' (the help they use) and 'số từ' (word counts) read naturally, and that 'không bao giờ là nội dung họ viết' is clear. | Review: English is conditional ('would only use'); Vietnamese stated it as already happening. Must match consent form wording. [Reviewer changed: Nghiên cứu chỉ dùng → Nghiên cứu sẽ chỉ dùng]
pages.organisations.privacy3.back: Parents' consent. Before any learning data is shared with Thinkerwell, the parent or guardian signs a consent form, and the learner agrees too. The research uses only data tied to a code, never tied to a name: short questions and a few written sentences in the first and last sessions, and, in every session, how the learner uses Thinkerwell: time, lessons and steps, answers, the help they use, videos and word counts, never what they write.

Do you want your answers to be part of the study?

Would you like your answers to be part of the study?

pages.pilotStudy.intro.source: If you say yes to the study, then in the first and last sessions your child:

pages.pilotStudy.intro.back: If you agree for your child to take part in the study, then in the first session and the last session, your child:

pages.pilotStudy.questions.source: answers 16 short questions (about 15 minutes each time)

pages.pilotStudy.questions.back: answers 16 short questions (about 15 minutes each time)

pages.pilotStudy.writing.back: writes a few sentences about a fictional town, on paper (about 8 minutes)

pages.pilotStudy.faces.source: chooses a face for each of 5 sentences, like “I can use a map to find information” (about 1 minute)
pages.pilotStudy.faces.note: PROMISE: 5 sentences, about 1 minute. Example sentence is in the learner's voice (Mình có thể ...); check it matches the self-check wording in the real instrument.
pages.pilotStudy.faces.back: chooses a face for each of 5 questions, for example "I can use a map to find information" (about 1 minute)

pages.pilotStudy.site.source: In every session, Thinkerwell also notes how your child uses it: how long, which lessons and steps they open and finish, their answers to quick checks and quizzes, whether they use the simpler reading or have it read aloud, whether they watch the videos (and how much) or read instead, and how many words they write, never the words themselves.
pages.pilotStudy.site.note: PROMISE covering all measurement logging: time, lessons and steps opened/finished, quick-check and quiz answers ('ôn tập phần' for quizzes), simpler reading, Listen ('nghe đọc to'), videos or read instead, word counts never the words. Must stay in step with MEASUREMENT_PLAN. Native + team check. | Review: Promise checked item by item against English: time, lessons and steps opened and finished, quick-check and section-check answers, simpler reading, Listen, videos or reading instead, word counts and never the words. All present. 'ôn tập phần' renders 'quizzes' (the section check term).
pages.pilotStudy.site.back: In every session, Thinkerwell also records how your child uses it: how long they use it, which lessons and steps they open and complete, the answers to quick checks and section reviews, whether they use the easier reading version or listening aloud, whether they watch videos (and how much) or read instead, and how many words they write, never recording those words themselves.

pages.pilotStudy.notTest.source: None of this is a test. Nothing depends on the answers.
pages.pilotStudy.notTest.note: PROMISE. 'bài kiểm tra' for test; native check that 'Không có gì phụ thuộc vào các câu trả lời' reads as 'nothing depends on the answers'.
pages.pilotStudy.notTest.back: None of this is a test. Nothing depends on the answers.

pages.pilotStudy.keepNeverAsk.back: Thinkerwell never asks about family, journey, hometown, religion or ethnicity.

pages.pilotStudy.keepNoDocuments.note: PROMISE: never asks for UNHCR numbers or documents.
pages.pilotStudy.keepNoDocuments.back: Thinkerwell never asks for a UNHCR number or any documents.

pages.pilotStudy.keepNoPhotos.source: Thinkerwell never collects photos of your child, or where they are.
pages.pilotStudy.keepNoPhotos.note: PROMISE. 'vị trí của con' for 'where they are' (location): check it means where the child physically is.
pages.pilotStudy.keepNoPhotos.back: Thinkerwell never collects photos of your child, or their location.

pages.pilotStudy.keepDevice.source: What your child writes and records in the lessons stays on the device they use.
pages.pilotStudy.keepDevice.note: PROMISE: writing and recordings stay on the device.
pages.pilotStudy.keepDevice.back: What your child writes and records in the lessons stays on the device they use.

siteVideo.explore.p1.source: Every learner deserves the chance to explore the world they live in. But across Southeast Asia, many youth face barriers to education. In Myanmar, about 3.8 million people are displaced inside their own country. In Malaysia, refugee children can't attend government schools. And in East Asia and the Pacific, one in three school-age children had no internet at home.
siteVideo.explore.p1.note: Figures kept (3,8 triệu, one in three). 'Barriers to education' as 'rào cản trong việc học'; 'displaced inside their own country' paraphrased in plain words; Myanmar kept as the name (check usual Vietnamese form and any political sensitivity).
siteVideo.explore.p1.back: Every learner deserves a chance to explore the world they live in. But across Southeast Asia, many youth face barriers to learning. In Myanmar, about 3.8 million people have had to leave where they live but are still inside their own country. In Malaysia, refugee children cannot go to public schools. And in East Asia and the Pacific, one in every three school-age children has no internet at home.

siteVideo.explore.p2.source: Where schools are stretched, lessons often stick to the basics: reading, maths, and skills for a job. Those matter. But there's little room left for the skills that open up the world: thinking critically, communicating with evidence, and taking other perspectives.
siteVideo.explore.p2.note: 'Stretched' as 'quá tải'; 'skills for a job' as 'kỹ năng để làm việc'. Check naturalness. | Review: "bằng bằng" was awkward; English "communicating with evidence". [Reviewer changed: Ở những nơi trường học đang quá tải, bài học thường chỉ xoay quanh những điều cơ bản: đọc, toán và kỹ năng để làm việc. Những điều đó rất quan trọng. Nhưng còn rất ít chỗ cho những kỹ năng mở ra cả thế giới: suy nghĩ phản biện, trình bày bằng bằng chứng và nhìn từ góc nhìn của người khác. → Ở những nơi trường học đang quá tải, bài học thường chỉ xoay quanh những điều cơ bản: đọc, toán và kỹ năng để làm việc. Những điều đó rất quan trọng. Nhưng còn rất ít chỗ cho những kỹ năng mở ra cả thế giới: suy nghĩ phản biện, trình bày có bằng chứng và nhìn từ góc nhìn của người khác.]
siteVideo.explore.p2.back: In places where schools are overcrowded, lessons often revolve only around the basics: reading, math and skills for work. Those things matter a lot. But there is very little room for the skills that open up the whole world: critical thinking, presenting with evidence, and looking from other people's point of view.

siteVideo.explore.p3.source: Research backs this up. In a Stanford study, students who learned history by questioning real sources grew more in historical thinking, reading, and knowledge than students in regular classes.
siteVideo.explore.p3.note: Stanford kept without 'Đại học'. 'Học sinh' used for the study's students.
siteVideo.explore.p3.back: Research supports this. In a Stanford study, students who learned history by questioning real sources progressed more in historical thinking, reading skills and knowledge than students in ordinary classes.

siteVideo.explore.p4.source: That's why we built Thinkerwell: free lessons in social studies and beyond, for youth facing barriers to education. Our first course, Exploring Our World, has 24 lessons in history, geography, culture, and civic life, and every lesson has five steps: read, write, speak, watch and reflect. Every reading has a simpler version and can be read aloud, and lessons work offline, in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
siteVideo.explore.p4.note: Motto 'Social studies and beyond' = 'Khoa học xã hội và hơn thế nữa' (used in p4, p6, session.p6, setup.p6); a native should confirm the motto. 'chúng mình' for the team speaking to learners. 'Nghe đọc thành tiếng' for read aloud. Bahasa Indonesia kept in English form; the video says lessons are in English and Bahasa Indonesia, left as is. | Review: Says lessons work offline "in English and Bahasa Indonesia" (true of the video). In Vietnamese the lessons are also translated; a human should decide whether to add Tiếng Việt to the video script or keep the faithful translation.
siteVideo.explore.p4.back: That is why we made Thinkerwell: free lessons in social science and more, for youth who face barriers to learning. Our first course, Exploring Our World, has 24 lessons about history, geography, culture and civic life, and each lesson has five steps: read, write, speak, watch and reflect. Every reading has an easier version and can be listened to read aloud, and the lessons work without a network, in English and Bahasa Indonesia.

siteVideo.explore.p5.source: Thinkerwell doesn't replace teachers. It lightens their load, with a ready-made guide for every lesson, plus answer keys and printables.
siteVideo.explore.p5.back: Thinkerwell does not replace teachers. The platform makes teachers' load lighter, with ready-made guides for each lesson, plus answers and materials to print.
